title: SMOK TFV18 Mini Tank 2ml
description: As part of Smok’s hugely popular TFV series of bestselling sub-ohm tank, the compact but powerful TFV18 Mini is a stylish tank that can be paired with most vape mods with its 510 threaded connection. Available in six colours, the TFV19 Mini is crowned with a classic-looking marble-effect, removable drip tip. An adjustable airflow ring lets you dial in to find your vape’s perfect intensity, from a tight, restricted draw to a light and airy experience. A sliding top-fill cap system makes refilling easy and mess-free with no need to separate the tank from the device. The included Smok V19 Mesh coils are built to last while delivering incredible flavour and cloud production. The 0.15-ohm coil is recommended for use between 89-100W, while the 0.2-ohm coil works best between 40-80W. Both provide a sublime DL (Direct Lung) sub-ohm experience when used with high-VG e-liquids. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
